name: RiseupVPN
description:
RiseupVPN is an easy-to-use, personal virtual private network (VPN) service operated by the Riseup collective. It routes your Internet traffic through encrypted tunnels to protect your privacy and circumvent censorship.

Features:
- One-click connection to secure, encrypted VPN gateways
- Zero user activity logging or traffic tracking maintained by the non-profit Riseup collective
- Automatic configuration without needing to manage OpenVPN configuration files manually
- DNS leak prevention and automatic kill-switch safeguarding connection drops
- Clean, unobtrusive desktop indicator interface
